responsibility: This machine-description fragment provides the ColdFire-specific DFA scheduler model for the m68k backend. It defines automata, cpu units, and instruction reservations for CFV1/2/3/4 cores, including instruction-buffer behavior, operand-execution pipelines, memory-bus use, MAC/EMAC/FPU resources, dual-issue restrictions, and latency/throughput classes keyed off insn attributes such as cpu, type, and op_mem. GCC’s scheduler consumes these reservations to model ColdFire pipeline hazards and issue timing, complementing the generic instruction patterns in m68k.md with microarchitectural timing data rather than instruction semantics.
